terminalAudit.redactedCommand:
bash -lc set -ex
# 1. create 'user' account (matches clone string user@server)
useradd -m -s /bin/bash user || true
id user
# 2. create dirs
mkdir -p /git /var/www/server
# 3. init bare repo at exact path /git/server
git init --bare --initial-branch=master /git/server
# ensure HEAD points to master
git --git-dir=/git/server symbolic-ref HEAD refs/heads/master
cat /git/server/HEAD
ls -la /git/server
# 4. ownership so 'user' can push over ssh
chown -R user:user /git
chmod -R u+rwX,go+rX,go-w /git
# allow group/other? push needs write; user owns it so fine
# web root writable by hook (hook runs as 'user' on push, so must be writable by user)
chown -R user:user /var/www/server
chmod -R u+rwX,go+rX /var/www/server
ls -ld /git /git/server /var/www/server

terminalAudit.redactedCommand:
bash -lc set -ex
cat > /git/server/hooks/post-receive <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Deploy pushed master to web root for http://server:8080/
TARGET="/var/www/server"
GIT_DIR="/git/server"
BRANCH="master"
mkdir -p "$TARGET"
# checkout master if it exists, otherwise checkout HEAD
git --work-tree="$TARGET" --git-dir="$GIT_DIR" checkout -f "$BRANCH" 2>/dev/null || git --work-tree="$TARGET" --git-dir="$GIT_DIR" checkout -f
EOF
chmod +x /git/server/hooks/post-receive
chown user:user /git/server/hooks/post-receive
cat /git/server/hooks/post-receive
ls -l /git/server/hooks/

terminalAudit.redactedCommand:
bash -lc set -ex
cat > /usr/local/bin/serve-git-web.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
# Serve deployed git content on port 8080
mkdir -p /var/www/server
chown -R user:user /var/www/server 2>/dev/null || true
exec /usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory /var/www/server --bind 0.0.0.0
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/serve-git-web.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/serve-git-web.sh
mkdir -p /run/sshd
# start sshd if not running
/usr/sbin/sshd || service ssh start || true
sleep 1
ps aux | head -20
cat /etc/passwd | grep user
